avito_vs_others_structural_differences.summary: Avito has 5 extreme FK edges (mean>100 or max>10000) with max mean cardinality 114625.5 vs 212.8 for other datasets. The stream tables (VisitStream, SearchStream, PhoneRequestsStream) have no primary keys and extreme fan-out, creating the FK-join cardinality explosion that likely caused PRMP's catastrophic R²=-5046 on ad-ctr.
